title: Transient Burst Credits & Negotiated Minimums — Hosted API pricing prototype
creator: Ava Martinez
description: Prototype an alternative to fixed monthly minimums for Hosted API enterprise customers: offer time-limited burst credits and negotiable committed-minimum tiers that automatically amortize streaming handshake costs. Goal is to provide smoother on-ramp for customers with spiky conversational workloads while protecting Redwood unit economics.
hypothesis: If we provide transient burst credits plus negotiated soft minimums that convert to committed credits after 90 days, we will reduce sales friction for trials and decrease early churn among mid-market customers with bursty usage by 15% while preserving net revenue per committed unit within +/-5% of baseline.
success_metrics: 30-day retention for accounts with burst credits (+10%)
% requests covered by burst credits vs billed tokens
test_plan: 1) Select 12 mid-market trial accounts with conversational/agent workloads identified by Solutions Eng. 2) Offer two variants: A) 1-week burst credit bundle (10M tokens) + opt-in negotiated 3-month soft minimum; B) 4-week smaller burst (3M tokens) + no minimum. 3) Track usage, refunds/credits, rate of opt-in to negotiated minimum, latency telemetry and support volume. 4) Collect Security Questionnaire feedback from three enterprise buyers for negotiated terms. 5) Run internal A/B for 8 weeks before sign-off.
rollout_plan: - Week 0: finalize SLA language and SQ answers (Legal & Security). - Week 1: onboard pilot accounts, enable credit buckets in billing backend feature flag. - Weeks 2-8: monitor telemetry daily (tokens consumed, streaming handshake ratio, error rates). - Week 9: review with sales & solutions eng, decide expand/iterate/cancel. - If expand: bake into pricing page and portal with automated amortization calculator.
risks_and_mitigations: Risk: Customers gaming burst credits for sustained usage -> Mitigation: automated conversion to committed credits if sustained usage > threshold; prorated billing after window
Risk: Increased support during pilot on SQ/legal terms -> Mitigation: pre-schedule SQ Q&A sessions and provide standard contract addenda
Risk: Unexpected latency/throughput cost due to streaming handshake frequency -> Mitigation: instrument handshake telemetry and apply per-route caps
notes_for_engineering: Billing needs a transient credits model and amortization hook; runtime must surface per-request flag for 'burst-credit-covered' to telemetry. See ENG spike ticket ENG-1842 for backend changes. Estimate ~2 sprints of cross-team work if expanded.
